selected_script.angle: Thin disinfecting wipes just shred, pill up, and smear when rubbed against sticky kitchen grease; Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray instantly dissolves heavy oil film across trash can lids, range hoods, and BBQ shelves for a fast, zero-residue wipe.
selected_script.hook: Stop wasting thin wipes on sticky kitchen grease—they just shred and smear.

timeline_breakdown: 0-3s: Pain conflict close-up showing a hand vigorously rubbing a thin disinfecting wipe over a sticky, yellow-grease-coated kitchen trash can lid; the wipe drags, shreds into lint pills, and smears the sticky buildup without lifting it.

3-6s: Product quick solution where Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray enters immediately, misting the sticky grease and lint residue; the oily film dissolves on contact and a paper towel effortlessly wipes the surface completely clean in one smooth swipe.

6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result on a grease-splattered stainless steel range hood exterior, wiping through stubborn cooking splatter to reveal a mirror-bright, residue-free finish.
video_001_part_01.voiceover: Stop wasting thin wipes on sticky kitchen grease—they just shred and smear. Liapu Kitchen Spray breaks down heavy oil on contact so you can wipe it completely clean in seconds with zero sticky residue.

timeline_breakdown: 0-4s (Global 10-14s): Fast-cut scene 2 in a different outdoor usage environment showing an oily BBQ grill side shelf being sprayed with Liapu and wiped down to reveal smooth, clean metal instantly.
4-8s (Global 14-18s): Fast-cut scene 3 showing the final result across a bright, pristine home kitchen with gleaming stovetops, spotless countertops, and sparkling exterior appliances.
8-10s (Global 18-20s): Short light CTA with the Liapu bottle resting cleanly on the bright quartz countertop.
video_001_part_02.voiceover: From outdoor grill shelves to everyday kitchen splatter, get a sparkling clean finish without the harsh chemical film. Upgrade your kitchen cleanup today.
